description: BUFGMUX, BUFGMUX_1, BUFGMUX_CTRL and an asynchronous BUFGMUX are packed as BUFGCTRL sites
exercises: the packing of the BUFGMUX family into the BUFGCTRL site
the polarity of the IS_IGNORE*_INVERTED bits of a BUFGCTRL
why: BUFGMUX, BUFGMUX_1 and BUFGMUX_CTRL had no packing branch and stopped the placer with "no BELs remaining to implement cell type 'BUFGMUX'". Vivado builds them as a BUFGCTRL: BUFGMUX and BUFGMUX_1 switch on the clock enables (CE0 = S through the site inverter, S0 = S1 = 1), BUFGMUX_CTRL on the selects (S1 = S, S0 = S inverted, CE0 = CE1 = 1), and IGNORE0/IGNORE1 are low, or high with CLK_SEL_TYPE "ASYNC". The site bits are written with the polarity of the pin, so IS_IGNORE*_INVERTED says that the signal is not inverted.
